# Anivora 0.1.42 — Fix native report verification on Android

- Correct the new Report Bug verification handoff on modern Android WebView. Android supplies a trusted source origin rather than a complete page URL; successful verification can now return to the native form and submit the report.
- Preserve strict challenge navigation, the fixed Cloudflare origin, matching request references, payload-bound receipts and server-side validation. Foreign origins, unrelated Worker paths, invalid receipts and mismatched references remain rejected.
- Add a real Android WebView regression test that executes the production receipt parser against WebMessageListener callbacks. Keep all existing download/playback/storage integration gates and add this tenth Android test.
- Preserve Report Bug's position below Support Anivora and above conditional Log out. Guests and signed-in users use the same flow; optional diagnostics remain off by default. No unrelated app features or controls change.

This corrects 0.1.41's “Verified. Returning to Anivora” stall. Android version code
**44**, newer than 0.1.41/code 43. Package `com.brandon300.anivora`; ARM64;
Android 7.0/API 24 or newer. Publication requires the established package, signer,
source, native-unit and Android integration verification gates.

Install over the existing app without uninstalling. Discord remains optional;
there is no Discord login, OAuth or account linking. The bot's name, app-icon
avatar and Administrator role remain unchanged. Cloudflare reporting is independent
of the suspended Render account backend. Native attachment upload is not offered.

Source commit: https://github.com/brandon-300/Anivora/commit/19f9243b52034e084163e255eebeb3ebf863de11
